description: Your magic is chaotic and unpredictable.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: When you cast, roll 1d20. On 1, roll d100 for random magical effect.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Bonus action for advantage on attack/ability check. Triggers wild magic surge.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Spend sorcery points to add/subtract from d20 rolls within 60 feet.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Reroll wild magic surge result. Can choose to use it or not.
